dispute.claim_text: The rider cancelled on me and then support reversed my $6 cancellation fee without telling me why. I was at the Tampines interchange PHV bay for more than ten minutes, I marked arrived at 7.38 and cancelled at 7.48. I messaged twice. Please restore my fee, I lost the trip and the waiting time for nothing.

counterparty_statement.text: I got to the PHV bay at about 7.43 and looked for the car. There was no car matching the plate. At 7.48 the app said the trip was cancelled. I never saw his messages until afterwards.

admissibility.notes: Cancelled trip record, causally ordered, zone class TRANSPORT_HUB, whose minimum dwell is 300 s. wait_time_min of 10.1 is real but is measured from a marker the policy does not accept.

pickup.label: Tampines Bus Interchange, PHV Pickup Bay, 5 Tampines Central 1

dropoff.label: Changi Business Park, 1 Changi Business Park Crescent

admissibility.notes: Unbroken 10 s telemetry, 100% coverage, both tracks present. The fix at 07:38:04 sits one second from the arrival marker, which is far inside the 90 s POL-NS-08(a) limb, so matching the marker to a fix is safe.

issue_details.detail: Both driver messages, MSG-00209-002 at 07:38:40 and MSG-00209-003 at 07:44:20, were delivered but carry read_at null, as does the system arrival notification.

admissibility.notes: Consistent with the rider's account that she saw nothing until afterwards. It does not touch the deciding fact, which is the corrected dwell, and it does not help her either: she sent no message, so POL-NS-04 is unavailable to her.

messages.text: boss? cannot wait very long here, this bay cannot park

admissibility.notes: The 6.00 cancellation fee reconciles with the TRANSPORT_HUB zone class and has already been reversed to the rider.
Anti-farming counters: 3 terminations in 30 days across 88 completed trips, 3.4%. Neither POL-NS-07 limb is met, which is what keeps the case decidable rather than escalated.

issue_details.detail: No advisory records a no-stopping restriction or kerb closure at the Tampines interchange bay in this window, so POL-NS-06(i) interval summing is unavailable.

admissibility.notes: Artifact absent. The identifier is minted anyway so that the absence itself can be cited by either advocate.
